_comment: Example of the product_lead_weekly section of config.json. Setup (references/setup.md) writes it. Every value is a placeholder. Don't commit a real config to a shared repo.

team._comment: auto_detect re-derives pms each run from product areas -> features -> owner (tracker only). Otherwise pms is a static list.

pm_updates._comment: source: paste, folder, or tracker. Pasted updates are always read too.

sources._comment: read_all on a Slack channel entry: true reads every post in the window without the relevance filter (small channels; personal, HR, and bot posts are still left out); false (default) keeps only posts by or mentioning the lead or naming an area or PM.

template._comment: source: default, match_existing, or custom. tracks_customer_commitments: true only if the team tracks commitments to named customers; false skips that prompt.

schedule._comment: Standalone only. Under the `daily-digest` conductor the rollup day lives in the conductor's cadence (weekly-<day>) and this section is not used. If no day is set, the first working day of the week is the default.

style._comment: mode: match_prior, structured, prose, or hybrid. absent_pm_handling: mention, omit, or footer.

review_step._comment: Tracker mode only. notify: chat (tell the user in chat), slack_dm (chat plus a Slack DM to user.slack_user_id), or none. Setup Step 12 saves the value that matches the user's choice.

last_run._comment: status: delivered, published, failed, or skipped_no_pm_updates.
